patches.description: Backport of the verified 7-PR Apple M5 Ultra Metal 4.1 stack (TF_DSV41_FP64_BF16=1) onto TensorFold v1.3.3 with 0 modified upstream .metal files: M5 NAX dense FP8 + tensor-unit MXFP4 prefill, fast DSpark NAX/MXFP4 projections, concurrent batched DSpark ingest + GPU blit undo + fused gate_plan_dspark, bidirectional DSpark block attention, top-K single-TG GPU Markov chain (TF_DSV41_MARKOV_TOPK), unified GPU filtered/multi-slot behind-the-verify picks, automatic pure-nucleus speculation, and confidence-guided adaptive block width.

Add TF_DSV41_M5_FAST_DECODE=1 hybrid serve mode under TF_DSV41_FP64_BF16=1: combines M5 Ultra NAX FP8 + tensor-unit MXFP4 prompt prefill and the full PR 3-7 DSpark drafting stack with stock v1.3.3 FP32 hardware-MMA target decode/verify (fp8_rows, fp8_tile, experts, engram) for maximum end-to-end throughput.

Apple M5 Ultra Metal 4.1 kernel research stack (0 modified upstream .metal files): lossless 128B/16KiB repacked checkpoint support (including zero-copy DSpark mtp-0..2 + repacked engram_manifest verification), Layer-1 Engram in pageable host RAM + SIMD E4M3 decode + cross-band row deduplication, layer-band encoder schedule (32 chunks) with 4-chunk cross-chunk routed expert batching and boot-audited staged Folded-E4M3 experts, single-pass NAX dense FP8 (keeping wo_a compact FP8), 16-head NAX prefill attention with fused grouped WO-A + fused grouped WO-B + in-place query RoPE, tensor-unit indexer decode, reversible coalesced BF16 vocab head, fused postnorm_expert + direct-slot MXFP4 verify experts, and plain_streams=5 optimal concurrent switch.
